title: Identify polygons (closed shapes with straight sides) and name them by number of sides

lesson.title: What Makes a Shape a Polygon?

steps.say: You already know shapes like triangles and rectangles from the hopscotch squares on the playground. Today we learn one small thing: how to tell if a shape is a polygon, and how to name it just by counting its sides.

A polygon has two rules. Rule one, it is closed, with no gaps, like a fence all the way around a yard. Rule two, every single side is straight, no curves and no bending. Here is a triangle. Trace it with your finger. It closes up, and all three sides are straight, so it is a polygon.

visual.caption: Closed, and every side is straight — this is a polygon

steps.say: Now here is the naming part. We just count the straight sides. Three sides is a triangle. Four sides is a quadrilateral. Five sides is a pentagon, and six sides is a hexagon. Look at this rectangle. Count with me, one, two, three, four straight sides. Four sides means it is a quadrilateral.

Here is the mistake I see a lot. Some kids look at a half circle, or a full circle like a loonie, and say it is a polygon because it is closed. But watch the edge. It curves! A polygon needs every side to be straight, so a circle is not a polygon at all, and a half circle is not either, because its round part is curved. Closed is not enough. Closed AND all straight.

visual.caption: Closed, but the edge curves — NOT a polygon

steps.say: So remember: closed, all straight sides, then count the sides to name it. That is all a polygon is.

lesson.answer: A polygon is closed with every side straight — then just count the sides to name it: 3 is a triangle, 4 is a quadrilateral.

practice.question: Your family has a garden box at the community garden. It is a rectangle, 3 metres long and 2 metres wide. Draw it on your paper. Is it a polygon? How many straight sides does it have, and what do we call a shape with that many sides?
practice.answer: Yes, it is a polygon — it is closed and all of its sides are straight. It has 4 straight sides, so it is a quadrilateral. A rectangle is one kind of quadrilateral.
